slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第十九章造化金身
“造化金身。”
半晌之后，方羽喃喃自语道。
随后方羽开始，认真的参悟起脑海中那一道道符文。
转眼时间就过去了一个时辰。
方羽才缓缓睁开双眼，方羽眼中露出了兴奋的神色。
“修炼至巅峰，居然能够凝聚出造化圣体，断肢重续，滴血重生。”
方羽一脸兴奋的自语道。
但是很快方羽脸上的兴奋之色。
“先修炼出造化之气吧，那些离你还太远了。”
造化神碑估计是看不过去了，直接出言打击。
方羽听到之后，不以为意，抑制住内心的兴奋。
接着方羽施展镇龙桩的同时，开始引动大地之力，流转周身，大地之力在气劲的引导下，根据造化金身行功路线，不断在体内流转，开始淬炼着方羽的肉身。
时间缓缓流逝，又过去了半个时辰，方羽感觉全身暖阳阳的。
“这就是造化之气吗?”
方羽感受到四肢百骸之中，那股微弱的气体喃喃开口说道，这气体散发着青光，透体而出，方羽伸出手来，看着其上的造化之气。
随后方羽伸出手来，右手气劲凝于食指之上，接着朝着左臂就是一个划拉。
那左臂直接被划开一道伤口，鲜血缓缓流出。
方羽心念一动，体内的造化之气朝着伤口涌去。
随着造化之气涌入伤口，那细小的伤口，鲜血缓缓止住，一盏茶工夫不到，原本鲜血直流的伤口，已然结痂。
“这效果太好了吧，我这才修炼的第一层，而且仅仅是修炼出造化之气，居然让我恢复力，上升了数倍不止。”
方羽喃喃开口说道。
先前造化神碑只是将造化金身的第一层功法传给了他。
造化金身第一层功法，修炼至圆满，能够让方羽的肉身提升到堪比灵武境巅峰的层次。
跟造化天经一般。
“有了这造化之气，你可以冲击锻体十重了，哪怕你冲击失败，奇经八脉受损，造化之气保住经脉，将其伤害降到最低，并且还能缓缓恢复你的伤势。”
就在此时，方羽的脑海中，浮现出一段话。
方羽看到之后，微微颔首。
脸上也不由露出了振奋之色。
有了造化神碑之言，他可以放心冲击锻体十重了。
没有迟疑，方羽施展镇龙桩，同时运转造化金身，大地之力自脚下不断涌入方羽的体内。
方羽将大地之力一分为二，一部分裹挟着气劲不断温养奇经八脉，一部分大地之力，流转全身，不断淬炼肉身，提升造化之气的强度。
值得一说的是，这万剑山的大地之力，比之九号矿坑，浓郁了数倍不止。
剑阁立阁于此，也不是没有原因的。
方羽此时开始温养奇经八脉的第一脉任脉。
奇经八脉分别是：任脉、督脉、冲脉、带脉、阴跷脉、阳跷脉、阴维脉、阳维脉。
任脉起于胞中，下出于会阴，经阴阜，沿腹部正中线上行，经咽喉部（天突穴），到达下唇内，左右分行，环绕口唇，交会于督脉之龈交穴，再分别通过鼻翼两旁，上至眼眶下（承泣穴），交于足阳明经。
由胞中贯脊，向上循行于背部。
大地之力裹挟着气劲，不断温养着任脉，但是因为气劲过于刚猛，任脉过去脆弱，所以方羽在温养之时，虽然特别小心，但是任脉依旧不断传来刺痛感。
好在这股刺痛感，倒也在他的接受范围之内。
“叩叩。”
“方师弟。”
就在此时，门外传来了连立的声音，方羽当下收功，站起身来。
方羽打开屋门，看着门外的连立，只见连立抱着被褥，以及各种生活用品站在门外。

Chapter 19: Creating a Golden Body
"Create a golden body."
After a while, Fang Yu murmured to himself.
Then Fang Yu began to carefully comprehend the runes in his mind.
An hour passed in the blink of an eye.
Fang Yu slowly opened his eyes, and Fang Yu's eyes showed excitement.
"When you reach the peak of your cultivation, you can actually condense the Holy Body of Creation, regenerate severed limbs, and regenerate with a drop of blood."
Fang Yu said to himself excitedly.
But soon Fang Yu's face showed excitement.
"Cultivation of the Qi of Creation first, that is still too far away from you."
The Monument of Creation probably couldn't stand it, so he directly attacked him with words.
After Fang Yu heard it, he didn't take it seriously and suppressed his excitement.
Then, while Fang Yu used the dragon-suppressing stake, he began to induce the power of the earth to flow around his body. Under the guidance of Qi Jin, the power of the earth continued to circulate in the body according to the path of the creation of the golden body, and began to temper Fang Yu's body.
Time passed slowly, and another half hour passed, and Fang Yu felt warm and yangyang all over his body.
"Is this the Qi of Creation?"
Fang Yu felt the weak gas in his limbs and murmured. The gas was emitting green light and came out through the body. Fang Yu stretched out his hand and looked at the gas of creation on it.
Then Fang Yu stretched out his hand, concentrated the energy of his right hand on his index finger, and then made a swipe towards his left arm.
A wound was opened directly on the left arm, and blood slowly flowed out.
Fang Yu thought, and the energy of creation in his body surged towards the wound.
As the energy of creation poured into the wound, the blood from the small wound slowly stopped. In less than a cup of tea, the wound that was originally bleeding had scabbed over.
"This effect is so good. I have only reached the first level of cultivation, and I only cultivated the Qi of Creation. My recovery power has increased several times."
Fang Yu murmured.
Previously, the Divine Monument of Creation only passed on to him the first level of techniques for creating a golden body.
The first level of skills for creating a golden body, practiced to perfection, can elevate Fang Yu's physical body to a level comparable to the peak of the spiritual martial arts realm.
It's like the scripture of creation.
"With this Qi of Creation, you can attack the tenth level of body forging. Even if your impact fails and the eight extraordinary meridians are damaged, the Qi of Creation will protect the meridians, minimize their damage, and slowly recover your injuries."
At this moment, a sentence appeared in Fang Yu's mind.
After Fang Yu saw it, he nodded slightly.
There was also a look of excitement on his face.
With the words of the Creation Monument, he can safely attack the tenth level of body forging.
Without hesitation, Fang Yu used the dragon-suppressing stake and at the same time rotated the golden body of creation. The power of the earth continued to pour into Fang Yu's body from under his feet.
Fang Yu divided the power of the earth into two parts, one part of which was wrapped with Qi to continuously warm and nourish the eight extraordinary meridians, and part of the power of the earth circulated throughout the body, constantly tempering the physical body, and increasing the intensity of the Qi of Creation.
It is worth mentioning that the power of the earth in Wanjian Mountain is many times stronger than that in Mine No. 9.
It is not without reason that Jiange set up its pavilion here.
At this time, Fang Yu began to warm and nourish the Ren meridian, the first of the eight extraordinary meridians.
The eight extra meridians are: Ren meridian, Du meridian, Chong meridian, Dai meridian, Yin Qiao meridian, Yang Qiao meridian, Yin Wei meridian and Yang Wei meridian.
The Ren meridian originates from the center of the cell, goes down from the perineum, passes through the mons pubis, goes up along the midline of the abdomen, passes through the throat (Tiantu point), reaches the inside of the lower lip, branches to the left and right, surrounds the lips, meets at the Gujiao point of the Du meridian, then passes through both sides of the nose, up to the lower eye orbit (Chengqi point), and joins the Foot Yangming meridian.
It runs through the spine from the center of the cell and runs upward on the back.
The power of the earth envelops the Qi Jin and constantly warms and nourishes the Ren Meridian. However, because the Qi Jin is too strong, the Ren Meridian was fragile in the past. Therefore, although Fang Yu was very careful when warming and nourishing, the Ren Meridian still continued to feel a tingling sensation.
Fortunately, this stinging sensation was within his tolerance.
"Knock knock."
"Junior Brother Fang."
At this moment, Lian Li's voice came from outside the door, and Fang Yu immediately stopped and stood up.
Fang Yu opened the door and looked at Lian Li outside the door. He saw Lian Li standing outside the door holding a bedding and various daily necessities.
